Kf.bar_b_note: A dark, low-contrast mole on a neutral grey stage with faint poses that barely differ from standing has neither Palworld creature appeal nor any Valheim-class light to carry it.

Ra.bar_b_note: The spined hedgehog has a strong naturalistic silhouette, but faint poses that read as a crouch and (on B) an airborne flinch sink it below shipping finish.

Ca.bar_b_note: The elder is appealing with readable eyes and a Meadows olive/brown palette, but it is a stage capture with no world light or atmosphere, and its soft cartoon face sits a step off the naturalistic bar.

Yb.bar_b_note: A's ram matches the owner's Stormcapra bar with a clear rearing flinch and grounded faint, but the bare stage gives no Valheim-class light, and B's mangled, flattened faint mesh would sink it outright.

Hd.bar_b_note: The gold-green crested lizard reads well and lies flat when fainted, but the hopping hit react and a standing height barely over the trainer keep it short of Palworld finish.

Os.bar_b_note: B's timber frame, brace, cap and stone footing help, but a lone thin panel with flat tan infill beside a faceted grey placeholder rock in flat noon light is not Palworld base-building finish.

Wo.bar_b_note: The hedgehog model and spines are on-style, but A's airborne flinch and faint poses that read as a crouch rather than a collapse sink it.

Yf.bar_b_note: A's black-and-gold serpent is muddy and its hit react matches standing; B's bold yellow pattern reads far better but its faint poses hang the body high in the air with the shadow detached far below.

top_changes.change: Ground every reaction pose: keep hit-react flinches planted (no hop or lift, Ra B, Wo A, Hd A), give faint mid/end a real collapse onto the side rather than a crouch (Kf, Ra, Wo), and snap faint bodies to the stage (Yf B floating, Yb B mangled faint mesh).
Lift albedo value and add rim light/secondary colour on dark-coated creatures (Kf near-black fur, Yf A black-gold scales) so form and markings separate from the ground.

Replace the homestead wall with a thick multi-panel built wall: posts, plank or wattle-and-daub infill with texture, a cap/top rail and a distinct stone footing, so it reads as a wall rather than a single framed card.
